justification: Image A depicts an abstract schematic composition of geometric lines, ladder-like forms and comb-like radiating strokes with no recognizable figure or creature, while Image B depicts a naturalistic carved standing human figure with elaborate costume, headdress and glyph blocks. There is no correspondence in the kinds of elements shown, their relationships, or arrangement; the two surfaces belong to entirely different iconographic conventions (abstract linear marks versus figural relief with hieroglyphic panels).
